## tests/test_ssrf_catalog_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle: wire a CWE-918 (SSRF) entry into the live scan catalog.

Contract (brief_hooks_ngv2_ssrf_catalog_wire): the scan catalog is
``ngv2.pattern_scanner.VULN_PATTERNS``. The EDIT registers an ``ssrf`` entry so
the live scan path emits CWE-918 findings on outbound-HTTP sinks.

CRITICAL ANTI-DROP PIN (the lesson from T-deser-wire, which dropped existing
catalog entries because its oracle only pinned a SUBSET): this oracle pins the
FULL resulting catalog -- the exact key set AND every pre-existing entry
byte-identical -- so a whole-file worker emission can never silently drop an
existing pattern.
"""
from ngv2.pattern_scanner import VULN_PATTERNS, scan_file

# --- the six entries that MUST survive byte-for-byte (R-catalog-restore baseline) ---
EXPECTED_EXISTING = {
    'sql_injection': {'pattern': '(?:execute(?:many)?|executescript)\\s*\\(.*(?:%|\\.format\\b|\\+)', 'severity': 'high', 'cwe': 'CWE-89', 'owasp': 'A03:2021-Injection', 'languages': ['python', 'javascript', 'typescript', 'java', 'php'], 'description': 'Possible SQL injection via string formatting in a query call.'},
    'command_injection': {'pattern': '(?:os\\.system|subprocess\\.(?:call|run|Popen|check_output)|popen)\\s*\\(', 'severity': 'critical', 'cwe': 'CWE-78', 'owasp': 'A03:2021-Injection', 'languages': ['python', 'ruby', 'php', 'javascript', 'typescript'], 'description': 'Possible OS command injection via a shell/process call.'},
    'eval_usage': {'pattern': '\\beval\\s*\\(', 'severity': 'high', 'cwe': 'CWE-95', 'owasp': 'A03:2021-Injection', 'languages': ['python', 'javascript', 'typescript', 'php', 'ruby'], 'description': 'Use of eval() can execute arbitrary code.'},
    'weak_crypto': {'pattern': '(?i)\\b(?:md5|sha1|des|rc4)\\b', 'severity': 'medium', 'cwe': 'CWE-327', 'owasp': 'A02:2021-Cryptographic Failures', 'languages': ['python', 'javascript', 'typescript', 'java', 'php'], 'description': 'Use of a weak or broken cryptographic algorithm.'},
    'hardcoded_secret': {'pattern': '(?i)\\b(?:password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token)\\b\\s*[:=]\\s*[\'\\"][^\'\\"]+[\'\\"]', 'severity': 'high', 'cwe': 'CWE-798', 'owasp': 'A07:2021-Identification and Authentication Failures', 'languages': ['python', 'javascript', 'typescript', 'java', 'go', 'ruby', 'php', 'csharp'], 'description': 'Possible hardcoded credential assigned to a string literal.'},
    'insecure_deserialization': {'pattern': '\\b(?:pickle|cPickle|_pickle|marshal|joblib)\\.(?:loads|load)\\s*\\(|\\byaml\\.(?:unsafe_load|full_load|load)\\s*\\(|\\btorch\\.load\\s*\\(', 'severity': 'critical', 'cwe': 'CWE-502', 'owasp': 'A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures', 'languages': ['python'], 'description': 'Insecure deserialization of untrusted data via pickle/marshal/yaml.load/torch.load/joblib'},
}

# the FULL catalog after this leaf lands: the six existing + the new ssrf entry
EXPECTED_KEYS = set(EXPECTED_EXISTING) | {'ssrf'}


def test_full_catalog_keys_exact():
    # anti-drop: the catalog is EXACTLY the six survivors plus ssrf -- no more, no fewer
    assert set(VULN_PATTERNS) == EXPECTED_KEYS, (
        "VULN_PATTERNS keys drifted: %s" % sorted(VULN_PATTERNS))


def test_existing_entries_byte_identical():
    # every pre-existing entry survives byte-for-byte (no silent rewrite/drop)
    for key, meta in EXPECTED_EXISTING.items():
        assert key in VULN_PATTERNS, "dropped existing entry %r" % key
        assert VULN_PATTERNS[key] == meta, "mutated existing entry %r" % key


def test_catalog_gains_cwe_918_entry():
    entry = VULN_PATTERNS.get('ssrf')
    assert entry is not None, "VULN_PATTERNS has no ssrf entry"
    assert entry['cwe'] == 'CWE-918'
    assert 'python' in entry['languages']
    assert entry['severity'] == 'high'


def test_scan_file_flags_ssrf_sinks(tmp_path):
    target = tmp_path / "vuln.py"
    target.write_text(
        "import requests\n"
        "def fetch(user_url):\n"
        "    return requests.get(user_url)\n"
        "def grab(target):\n"
        "    import urllib.request\n"
        "    return urllib.request.urlopen(target)\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    findings = scan_file(target, "python")
    cwes = {f["cwe"] for f in findings}
    assert "CWE-918" in cwes
    lines = {f["line"] for f in findings if f["cwe"] == "CWE-918"}
    assert 3 in lines  # requests.get
    assert 6 in lines  # urllib.request.urlopen


# edge_case: a commented SSRF mention does not fire (catalog comment filter)
def test_commented_ssrf_not_flagged(tmp_path):
    target = tmp_path / "ok.py"
    target.write_text("# requests.get(url) is risky\nx = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert all(f["cwe"] != "CWE-918" for f in scan_file(target, "python"))


# edge_case: a sibling existing entry still fires unchanged after registration
def test_existing_command_injection_still_fires(tmp_path):
    target = tmp_path / "cmd.py"
    target.write_text("import os\nos.system(user_input)\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert any(f["cwe"] == "CWE-78" for f in scan_file(target, "python"))

```
